property_summary: After a transfer call, all token recipients must have received the exact amount v, i.e., balance changes of recipients are consistent with the intended transfer.
When transfer returns true, all calls to caddress.transferFrom must have succeeded (i.e., no call reverted).
The transfer function does not revert when called with a non-empty array of recipients.
The transfer function does not revert when called with at least one recipient.
The transfer function succeeds (does not revert) when called with an empty array of recipients.
The transfer function returns true (does not revert) when given a non-empty array of recipients and a valid caddress.
The transfer function does not revert when called with an empty array of recipients.
